verdict.rationale: Wave's own pricing page documents creating bills, and its receipts feature scans documents with OCR, so it covers the capture step of an AP workflow. Nothing in the pack documents approval routing or scheduling outbound vendor payments; its payment and recurring features cover customer invoicing, not paying vendors. missing for 10: bill approval routing, scheduled vendor bill payments, a single end-to-end AP workflow, OCR capture applied to vendor bills specifically, independent corroboration

support.subject: As an accountant, I can capture vendor bills, route them for approval, and schedule payments from one workflow

citations.quote: Create unlimited estimates, invoices, bills, and bookkeeping records
Our smart OCR technology extracts and organizes the data—meaning less manual input!
